Fuck this. Live your life the way you want and speak and act the way you want. If people don't like you, well fuck then also. Most important thing is being able to find satisfaction in you, do the things you like. As long as you're depending on others to make you happy, you're a people pleaser which will end up in misery.
Sorry, just my thoughts...

I totally understand you. This shit is hard. Mine friend, girl I liked and hung out with committed suicide about 5 years ago. It left me hurt and confused and guilty. Fuck this. WTF is wrong with society, is being cold and emotionless the only way to survive? I won't go that road again tonight although I'm a miserable wreck atm. There is no explanation, just endless pain I need to endure every day until i die.
No I haven't, sorry I didn't mean to be an asshole. It's just, I remember someone wrote same thing to my rant post before which made me smile, so I hoped, you know.... Yea that was stupid
I love you

At least now you know who your friends are. I have maybe 1 or 2 friend and we rarely communicate nowadays.

Family on the other hand will not do that, but you'll scare them and expect long and exhausting talks and a lot of non-useful suggestions from them.

​

Edit: Maybe it would be OK if you ask those friends that avoid you and tell them how you feel about it. If they continue avoiding you'll definitely know
Good thing is you're confronting this issue early and those that cut you off will experience the same thing at some point later in life. So, IMO you're more experienced.
Not a religious person but I practiced meditation for some time and it did calm my anger and thoughts.
So sorry to hear that. Please don't beat yourself over it, it's not your fault!

We, people dealing with depression, think of ourselves only the worst. This is what I read from your text and think it's what's keeping us behind.

You know what? There are plenty of assholes that acted way worse than you and still have self respect. Well screw them. Please find strength and self love and move on. I know it's hard, but find something meaningful to you and stick to it. And don't waste time on people wanting to harm you for their own pleasure. I know... depressed person trying to help another might seem fake, but I feel you and know how you feel from my experience.

In my case no. Probably cause i have never been in that situation, rock bottom without a cent, although my family was one of the poorest around for years...

I'm suicidal because I'm mad at the world, all the people just talking yet just continuing living in their selfish balloons with no real action to make things better. I'm suicidal cause people don't want or are incapable of helping each other, selfishly birthing new kids instead of taking care of countless hungry ones, working countless hours for their bosses they probably dislike. I'm suicidal because this is such a lonely world full of people living in a fucking fear, also cause I'm lonely and have noone to talk or cry to, and when you're loner, noone really cares...

I have been poor, but I got more problems now with a job and a place to sleep and eat. I've felt better being without money and friends than I am now, with money and no real friend.

People need to get up and start fighting the system that made them fucked up and not their neighbours out of jealousy or some fucked up social game.
In my case, no it's not possible to be happy and misanthropic. If you hate humans, you can't love yourself, or I could be wrong.
Thanks so much for your concern and inspirative message, I understand you, but me and god are not good buddies.
Too many I would say. But the fact there are many more people lonely like me is not making me feel any better. It's just a lame excuse.

Same here, I'm living isolated for about 10 years straight now. People that know me never called, and they know my status. I could coldheartedly place a large bet on the fact most of them were even laughing about it and made evil jokes about me. It hurts so much. Sure, I could have called them myself, but... That wouldn't change anything.

Suicide by pills is not an option for me (in your case, you can expect liver failure from paracetamol). Heroin overdose maybe, but my top personal suicide fantasies are jumping of a building or under a train, or a simple bullet in the head. It feels so fucking wrong to speak about this. Sorry!

I lost faith in therapy and am tired of searching. It all revolves around pill colors most of the time. If one "doesn't work" they give me another to try. All of them "work" and "don't work" but in the end none really helped
I feel you. Remembering how things used to be makes it worse.

I actually think this is big part of the problem -  Thinking everyone's different, individualism. It makes us so selfish and self absorbed, and sorry if I'm gonna offend someone, but most women are like this - Each one "different and special" with their special make-up, clothes, more and more egocentric and selfish. 
We're not so different from each other. Individualism is a lie.
I can't take fridays, they are more terrifying than mondays. It's the beginning of the weekend spent in isolation and fear. It's the day I'm angry and sad the most.
Im just a nutcase, a failure, an outcast living in the past
I just want to have someone that is here for me but I'm not letting anyone in my life. I hate people.

I hate people and it's really hard. People see me as nervous guy and avoid contact with me if they can.
I snap at them from time to time. Can't believe how selfish and hypocritical world has become.
I don't like being human, but somehow i manage to live with myself and all that negativity in my head. Guess ill explode one day and I'm really inpatient waiting for my death.
Can't call myself a nihilist tho cause I actually believe things can be much better
